title: Legacy API Modernization with Copilot Agents
business: Enterprise software teams maintaining monolithic legacy systems
problem: Developers spend excessive time manually refactoring outdated API patterns, leading to inconsistent error handling and slow feature delivery.
solution: Utilizing GitHub Copilot agentic capabilities to research repository patterns, propose refactoring plans, and generate pull requests for standardized API implementations.
steps: Define the target API modernization pattern in repository instructions to provide context.
Invoke a Copilot agent to research existing legacy endpoints and identify refactoring candidates.
Review the agent-generated plan and authorize the creation of a draft pull request.
Validate the agent's proposed code changes and security mitigations before merging.
outcome: Increased developer velocity through automated boilerplate generation and consistent adherence to modern API standards across the codebase.
limitation: The agent may propose changes that conflict with undocumented side effects; verify by checking the generated pull request diffs against existing test coverage.
